#!/usr/bin/python3
import os,time
for _ in range(1500):
 if os.path.exists(os.environ["HOME"]+"/OPEN.release"):break
 time.sleep(.01)
with open("pipe","rb")as f: data=f.read()
open(os.environ["HOME"]+"/received","wb").write(data)
